subject: Onboarding route clarification — econ buyer, PO routing & timeline
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Onboarding route clarification — econ buyer, PO routing & timeline

Hi Samir — thanks for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we don’t lose momentum: 

1) Key stakeholders you mentioned:
   - Economic buyer: Anya Zhou (VP Finance) — final sign-off for PO/contract
   - Security: internal SOC/compliance team (we’ll leave this to you to loop)
   - Procurement / AP: procurements@equityhealth.com

2) What we need from Equity Health to start vendor intake:
   - Completed vendor_intake_form.xlsx (I attached a blank copy)
   - W-9 or equivalent tax docs (we can provide ours: redwood_w9.pdf attached)
   - Any standard contract redlines or PO terms your team requires

3) Redwood outputs for procurement and finance: 
   - Draft SOW for pilot (attached EQH_SOW_v0.3.pdf) — please confirm scope & deliverables
   - Typical billing cadence: Net 30 after invoice (can be adjusted if you require Net 45/60)

4) Proposed timeline (flexible):
   - This week: you share econ buyer / procurement contact confirmations and vendor intake form
   - Next week: procurement sends PO or routing instructions; we prepare DocuSign SOW
   - 2–3 weeks: pilot kickoff once PO & SOA signed and onboarding packet completed

Can you confirm that Anya is the econ buyer and whether procurement requires a PO before onboarding work starts? If it helps, Marissa can draft a short mutual action plan for procurement milestones.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if needed.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
phone: (415) 555-0132

Attachments:
- EQH_SOW_v0.3.pdf (pdf, 165 KB)
- vendor_intake_form.xlsx (xlsx, 24 KB)

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@equityhealth.com>

Subject: Re: Onboarding route clarification — econ buyer, PO routing & timeline

Hi Karthik — thanks for the clear note. Confirming a few items from our side: 

- Anya is the econ buyer and will sign the PO/SOW. I’ve CC’d her.
- Procurement is run by our central team at procurements@equityhealth.com; they usually require a vendor intake form + W-9 before issuing a PO.
- Typical internal timeline: vendor intake -> vendor validation (2 business days) -> PO issuance (5–10 business days) after validation. Can be faster if Anya prioritizes.

Two asks from our ops team: 
1) Would Redwood accept a two-stage process (PO for pilot value first, followed by full contract)? We prefer splitting larger pilots for approvals.
2) We need a copy of your SOC 2 or security questionnaire answers to share with compliance — do you have that available?

I’ll start the intake form and return it by EOD Monday. If the W-9 and SOW are attached, that helps speed things up.

—Samir
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Equity Health
procurements@equityhealth.com

Hi Samir / Anya — Marissa on the onboarding team. Quick notes on how we usually handle the items you asked about so procurement has a predictable path: 

- Two-stage PO: yes, we can accept an initial PO for the pilot value to unblock onboarding. We’ve done this with several customers; please make the PO reference our legal entity "Redwood Inference Inc." and include the Deal ID EQH-2027-042 in the PO notes.

- Security docs: I’ve attached a SOC2-summary.pdf and our standard security questionnaire export — if your compliance team wants the full report we can start an NDA or provide the SOC2 report via a secure portal.

- Vendor intake: when you return vendor_intake_form.xlsx, please include account billing code and AP contact; procurement often requests the vendor remit address (included in our W-9).

- Invoicing and billing cadence: we can invoice on milestone completion or monthly for pilot consumption. Invoices should be sent to payables@equityhealth.com (if different, include AP contact in intake form).

Next steps I'd suggest: 
1) Samir: send back completed vendor_intake_form.xlsx + attach the PO (if you have an initial PO) — we will treat that as the kickoff authorization.
2) Anya: if you can engage procurement and confirm desired PO cadence (single vs two-stage), that will set expectations.

If helpful I can draft a 1-page mutual action plan after I see the intake form (10–15 minute task).

Thanks — we’ll standby to expedite once intake + PO are in.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Onboarding Manager, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
